declared_gaps.title: Emotional-equivalence intensity has no evidentiary standard
declared_gaps.why: The mark scores each wound with an intensity float and calls the sum 'total emotional damage'. No recognised forum receives an intensity scale as evidence of harm, so no gate is implemented that would convert it into a finding. The checker records the layer as a declaration at tier C and refuses to let it count toward any figure, which is why the gap is declared rather than filled with an invented test.

One pillar still names no source at proof tier for the vendor's own conduct: the Deere mechanism cites the statutory instrument rather than a Deere document. A live, readable Deere record (repair-parts policy, service manual, dealer terms) is required before that premise is proven. The printer half of this declaration was closed on 2026-11-05 by HP's own dynamic-security document (tier B).

judged.independence: ONE model serving SIX angles. Angle diversity, not model diversity: six personas are not six independent judges.
